classes.description: 工艺路线步骤的生产排程和效率控制明细。物理上对应 StepSchedulingDetail (CdoId: 531)。 【Swagger】Schema: StepSchedulingDetailChanges；来源文件: AssemblyWorkflows.json；API: /api/AssemblyWorkflows。

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: durationPerUnit
properties.description: 物理字段 DurationPerUnit 【Swagger】This value specifies the amount of time needed to process a single unit. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: normalCycleTime
properties.description: 标准生产周期 【Swagger】This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming normal queue time. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

properties.name: fastCycleTime
properties.description: 快速周期时长 【Swagger】This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming fast queue time. This is used to determine, for example, how quickly a job can be expedited through the Factory. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

properties.name: runRateOption
properties.description: 物理字段 RunRateOption 【Swagger】This option determines if run rate is specified as hours per unit or units per hour or time per batch. The values and their meanings are: 1 = Hours per unit (RunRateTime) 2 = Unites per hour (RunRateQuantity) 3 = Time Per Batch (RunRate Time)

properties.name: stdBatchSize
properties.description: 标准批次数量 【Swagger】This value specifies the standard size of a batch of material processed using this Spec. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: unitsPerHour
properties.description: 每小时标准产能 【Swagger】This value specifies the number of units processed in an hour. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: yield
properties.description: 计划良率 【Swagger】Specifies the standard yield expected for processing with this Spec. This value is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: forwardCycleTime
properties.description: 物理字段 ForwardCycleTime 【Swagger】This is the sum of all NormalCycleTime from this step through the end of the Workflow (following defaults Paths from this Step forward). The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

properties.name: forwardYield
properties.description: 物理字段 ForwardYield 【Swagger】Standard (cumulative) yield from this step through the end of the Workflow (following defaults Paths from this Step forward). The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

properties.name: setupTime
properties.description: 准备换线时间 【Swagger】This value specifies the time required for a Setup at this Operation. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

properties.name: timePerBatch
properties.description: 物理字段 TimePerBatch 【Swagger】This value specified the time needed to process a single Batch.

properties.name: unscheduledTime
properties.description: 物理字段 UnscheduledTime 【Swagger】Process time that is not contained in the UPH,HPU or Batch Time entries.

classes.description: 定义流程跳转或操作触发时伴随的详细事务字段及逻辑行为。物理上对应 TxnDetails (CdoId: 679477423)。 【Swagger】Schema: TxnDetailsChanges；来源文件: AssemblyWorkflows.json；API: /api/AssemblyWorkflows。

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否冻结 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: txnType
properties.description: 事务操作类型编码 【Swagger】Type of transaction to use: 1 = Move to the To-Step 2 = Rework to the To-Step 3 = Combine to another Container at the To-Step

properties.name: reworkReason
properties.description: 物理字段 ReworkReasonId → ReworkReason 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: toContainerOption
properties.description: 物理字段 ToContainerOption 【Swagger】If the Transaction Type is Combine then this option is used to determine specifics of the Combine: 1 = Create the To-Container (using auto-naming if configured) 2 = Combine to a Specific Container (and create it if it does not exist)

properties.name: newOwner
properties.description: 物理字段 NewOwnerId → Owner 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: toContainerLevel
properties.description: 物理字段 ToContainerLevelId → ContainerLevel 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: toContainerName
properties.description: 物理字段 ToContainerName 【Swagger】Unique name for this instance
